#!/usr/bin/env python3
import re
from collections import defaultdict

# Parse gcode: track current object (M486 S0 => "Embossed text", S1 => "Shape-Box")
# and current Z. Collect extrusion moves (where E increases) per object and per Z.

obj_name = {0: "Embossed_text", 1: "Shape-Box"}
cur_obj = None  # set by M486 S<n>
x = y = z = 0.0
e = 0.0

# Per object: set of Z layer heights where extrusion happens
obj_z = defaultdict(set)
# Per object: count of extrusion segments
obj_seg = defaultdict(int)
# Per object: bounding box of extrusion points
obj_bbox = {}

all_z = set()

line_re = re.compile(r'^(G0|G1)\b(.*)')
def parse_params(rest):
    params = {}
    for m in re.finditer(r'([XYZEFS])(-?\d+\.?\d*)', rest):
        params[m.group(1)] = float(m.group(2))
    return params

with open('/app/text.gcode') as f:
    for line in f:
        s = line.strip()
        if not s:
            continue
        if s.startswith('M486'):
            # M486 S<n> sets current object id; A<name> names it; S-1 none
            parts = s.split()
            for p in parts[1:]:
                if p.startswith('S'):
                    val = int(float(p[1:]))
                    cur_obj = None if val < 0 else val
            continue
        if not (s.startswith('G0') or s.startswith('G1')):
            continue
        m = line_re.match(s)
        if not m:
            continue
        params = parse_params(m.group(2))
        nx = params.get('X', x)
        ny = params.get('Y', y)
        nz = params.get('Z', z)
        ne = params.get('E', None)

        extruding = False
        if ne is not None and ne > e + 1e-9:
            extruding = True
        if 'Z' in params:
            z = nz
        # update position
        if ne is not None:
            e = ne
        if extruding and cur_obj is not None:
            obj_z[cur_obj].add(round(z, 3))
            obj_seg[cur_obj] += 1
            # track bbox using both endpoints
            for (px, py) in [(x, y), (nx, ny)]:
                if cur_obj not in obj_bbox:
                    obj_bbox[cur_obj] = [px, py, px, py]
                else:
                    b = obj_bbox[cur_obj]
                    b[0] = min(b[0], px); b[1] = min(b[1], py)
                    b[2] = max(b[2], px); b[3] = max(b[3], py)
            all_z.add(round(z, 3))
        x = nx
        y = ny

print("Objects found:")
for o in sorted(obj_z.keys()):
    zs = sorted(obj_z[o])
    print(f"  Object {o} ({obj_name.get(o,'?')}): segments={obj_seg[o]}, num_z_layers={len(zs)}")
    print(f"    Z range: {min(zs)} .. {max(zs)}")
    print(f"    First few Z: {zs[:10]}")
    print(f"    Last few Z: {zs[-5:]}")
    b = obj_bbox[o]
    print(f"    XY bbox: X[{b[0]:.2f},{b[2]:.2f}] Y[{b[1]:.2f},{b[3]:.2f}]  size={b[2]-b[0]:.2f} x {b[3]-b[1]:.2f}")

print()
print(f"Total distinct Z layers overall: {len(all_z)}")
print("All Z sorted:", sorted(all_z)[:30], "..." if len(all_z) > 30 else "")
